bf16_dense_peak_basis: Measured-device ceiling: 132 enabled SM * 4096 dense BF16 tensor FLOPs/cycle/SM * the configured 1.980 GHz max SM clock.
bf16_public_reference_basis: Compatibility-only denominator: half of NVIDIA's public 1,979 TFLOPS sparse Hopper figure. It is not treated as the exact ceiling of this 140GB H800 SKU.
mfu_policy: Use the measured-device 1.07085824 PFLOPS dense ceiling for primary MFU. Retain 989.5 TFLOPS only as public-reference MFU for cross-report comparison. Never use 1,979 TFLOPS as a dense denominator.
